explanation: Adds deployGuards.test.ts for the two delivery guards: atlas completeness (manifest, validation report and every lookup/value shard, for public/ or dist/) and recognition of public-data-release bundles (fetch:data marker, KEGG_NOT_INCLUDED.md, empty macaque cpm, an all-empty KEGG corpus, and the narrower --only scope where one study may lack KEGG). It writes only temporary directories. The earlier hostname and regular-expression hardening of two assertions is unchanged.
